title: Planta Plant Care Event Health Score Leaderboard
dataSources: Planta plant care events (`planta:plant`), Govee soil readings (`govee:soil`), Philips Hue grow-light cycles (`hue:event`), and SensorPush dome climate (`sensorpush:climate`).
app: Planta reminders, Govee soil sensors, Philips Hue grow-light schedules, and SensorPush humidity-dome readings streamed into Splunk.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=planta:plant health_score=*
| stats sum(health_score) as total_value, avg(health_score) as avg_value by plant_name
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks plant name values by total and average health score across Planta plant care event events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `health_score` values for each Planta plant care event event and review total and average health score by plant name.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total health score.
grandmaExplanation: It compares which plant name shows the biggest health score numbers in your Planta plant care event data.
